summary: Linking people, groups and permissions on the Access map is quicker.

new.title: Link with Ctrl+click
new.text: Select a person or group, then hold Ctrl and click each target to add a link. A plain click still only selects, so nothing is linked by accident.

new.title: Link by drag and drop
new.text: Drag a box onto another box on the Access map. Only boxes that can accept it light up.

new.title: Link buttons in the toolbar
new.text: Give access, Add people, Add permissions and Give to a group now sit in the toolbar, named for what you selected. Every link is still committed on Review & Save.
